steps.title: Step #1: Open Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the button at the middle bottom of Safari to open the menu options.

steps.title: Step #2: Scroll Menu
steps.instruction: Scroll the menu up to reveal more options.

steps.title: Step #3: Add Bookmark
steps.instruction: Tap on 'Add Bookmark' (Ajouter un signet) to save the website.

steps.title: Step #4: Validate Installation
steps.instruction: Confirm the action to add the bookmark to your device.

steps.title: Step #5: Access from Home Screen
steps.instruction: The app is now available on your home screen for quick access.

steps.title: Step #1: Open Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the button at the middle bottom of Chrome to open the menu.

steps.title: Step #2: Scroll Menu
steps.instruction: Scroll the menu up to see more options.

steps.title: Step #3: Add to Home Screen
steps.instruction: Tap on 'Add to Home Screen' (Sur l'écran d'accueil) to install the app.

steps.title: Step #4: Validate Installation
steps.instruction: Confirm the action to add the app to your device.

steps.title: Step #5: Access from Home Screen
steps.instruction: The app is now available on your home screen for easy access.

steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Navigate to the website you want to add using Chrome.

steps.title: Open the Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the three dots menu icon in the top right corner.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home screen'
steps.instruction: Tap 'Add to Home screen' from the menu.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the name if needed, then tap 'Add'.

steps.title: Open the Website
steps.instruction: Go to the website you want to add using Microsoft Edge.

steps.title: Open the Menu
steps.instruction: Tap the three dots menu icon at the bottom center.

steps.title: Select 'Add to Home screen'
steps.instruction: Tap 'Add to Home screen' from the menu options.

steps.title: Confirm and Add
steps.instruction: Edit the shortcut name if you wish, then tap 'Add'.

steps.title: Step #1: Ouvrir le menu
steps.instruction: Appuyez sur le bouton au centre en bas de Safari pour ouvrir les options du menu.

steps.title: Step #2: Faire défiler le menu
steps.instruction: Faites défiler le menu vers le haut pour afficher plus d'options.

steps.title: Step #3: Ajouter un signet
steps.instruction: Appuyez sur 'Ajouter un signet' pour enregistrer le site web.

steps.title: Step #4: Valider l'installation
steps.instruction: Confirmez l'action pour ajouter le signet à votre appareil.

steps.title: Step #5: Accéder depuis l'écran d'accueil
steps.instruction: L'application est maintenant disponible sur votre écran d'accueil pour un accès rapide.
